messages:
Ben: kicking off release 2.3.0 canary at 10:30 PT
Ben: eval-bot posted gating results: https://internal.redwood/evals/1749004321
eval-bot: Automated eval summary — prompt set 'checkout_flow' — P@1 down 5.2% vs baseline, BLEU -1.3. Failing threshold for gating.
Carol: saw the evals, looks like tokenization change from v1.4.3-quant caused the hit. I'm rerunning with the dequantized variant.
Ben: hold canary rollout for now. deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by Ben.
Dave: changing routing to 0% for canary. Will hold traffic and monitor infra metrics.
Suzanne: ok — we should update release notes and call out known regression risk. I'll draft a blurb.
Carol: rerun done — dequant variant passes locally. But need cross-tenant check. Spawning `make eval PROMPT_SET=checkout_flow N=2000`
Carol: results: P@1 delta -0.3% (within tolerance). Sending full artifact to s3: s3://redwood-evals/runs/1749004321-dequant
Ben: plan: pin canary model to v1.4.2-compat while we verify v1.4.3-quant. If dequant variant still good after 2h, we can resume incremental canary.
Ben: action items: Carol -> confirm cross-tenant eval (ETA 45m), Dave -> keep canary at 0% and monitor, Suzanne -> update release notes with rollback note.
Carol: confirmed — cross-tenant evals all within thresholds. Recommend controlled resume to 5% for 30m, then 25% if stable.
deploy-bot: Resume request queued by Ben; awaiting SRE approval.
Dave: approving resume to 5% for 30m. I will watch p95 latency and error rates.
Ben: resuming canary to 5% now. deploy-bot: Canary updated to 5% traffic.
Carol: running quick smoke tests on sample tenants.
Suzanne: release note draft: "Deploy 2.3.0: initial canary paused due to a prompt-eval regression on checkout_flow. Recovered by pinning to v1.4.2-compat and validating dequant variant. Monitoring in progress."
Ben: thanks team. Keep notifications in this thread if anything spikes. If eval-bot flags >2% regression again, auto-rollback policy applies.
eval-bot: Monitoring active. Will post alerts for thresholds.
Dave: no anomalies in infra; metrics green.
Ben: last update — canary at 5% stable for 30m, escalating to 25%.
deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 25%.
Ben: moving to gradual rollout; closing thread after 4 hours of stability.
